rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a restaurant server when the female gender is understood from context or is not important.

example.english: The waitress helped me place my order.
example.jyutping: si6 jing3 bong1 ngo5 lok6 daan1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically need to make clear that the restaurant server is female.

example.english: That waitress had a very sweet smile.
example.jyutping: go2 wai2 neoi5 si6 jing3 siu3 dak1 hou2 tim4
